text:
BYU Duo is temporarily DISABLED (2026-11-10 ~12:40pm MT)

What happened: while standing the runners back up on the new host (the old
spare Mac went dark on Nov 3), several class repos started their cached-profile
CAS logins close together. BYU's Duo locked the account after the burst:
"Account disabled ... Your Duo account is disabled and cannot access this
application."

Automation state right now: every login attempt is stopped and the class runs
are cancelled so the lockout can cool down. No work is queued that will retry
by itself until the quiet-safe schedule (today 5pm-9:30pm MT).

What Zack may need to do: if the lockout does not clear on its own within about
an hour, restore Duo at duo.byu.edu or call BYU IT (801-422-4000, it@byu.edu).
This affects his own BYU logins, not just the runners.

Still open because of it:
- HRM 391: two Unit 1 Mid-term Checkpoints (1pt each), reopened by the TAs and
  open until Wed Nov 11 11:00am MT. Automatable, will run tonight.
- STRAT 392: Building Competitive Moats reading quiz (10pt), due today 11:59pm MT.
- IS 515: 16.6 Megaformulas Assessment (20pt), due Nov 11. The 14.9 Lookups
  (20/20) and 15.8 Text (19/20) assessments were submitted today.
- PSE 390: Week 9 quiz (10pt) is hard-locked since Nov 7; needs a reopen.
